uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: User switches out after damaging the target.

bulkup.name: Bulk Up
bulkup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

poisonfang.name: Poison Fang
poisonfang.desc: 50% chance to badly poison the target.

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.desc: User switches out after damaging the target.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.desc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.desc: More power the heavier the target.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerpunch.desc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

saltcure.name: Salt Cure
saltcure.desc: Deals 1/8 max HP each turn; 1/4 on Steel, Water.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.

bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugbuzz.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

headlongrush.name: Headlong Rush
headlongrush.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

nastyplot.name: Nasty Plot
nastyplot.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: User switches out after damaging the target.

focusblast.name: Focus Blast
focusblast.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
hypnosis.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

closecombat.name: Close Combat
closecombat.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

recover.name: Recover
recover.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

ironhead.name: Iron Head
ironhead.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

psystrike.name: Psystrike
psystrike.desc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

bodypress.name: Body Press
bodypress.desc: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidspin.desc: Free user from hazards/bind/Leech Seed; +1 Spe.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.desc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

drainpunch.name: Drain Punch
drainpunch.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
stickyweb.desc: Lowers Speed of grounded foes by 1 on switch-in.

protect.name: Protect
protect.desc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

kowtowcleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowcleave.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

energyball.name: Energy Ball
energyball.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

temperflare.name: Temper Flare
temperflare.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.desc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

playrough.name: Play Rough
playrough.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

knockoff.name: Knock Off
knockoff.desc: 1.5x damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.desc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.

aurasphere.name: Aura Sphere
aurasphere.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

throatchop.name: Throat Chop
throatchop.desc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

boosterenergy.name: Booster Energy
boosterenergy.desc: Activates the Protosynthesis or Quark Drive Abilities. Single use.

choicescarf.name: Choice Scarf
choicescarf.desc: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

rockyhelmet.name: Rocky Helmet
rockyhelmet.desc: If holder is hit by a contact move, the attacker loses 1/6 of its max HP.

choiceband.name: Choice Band
choiceband.desc: Holder's Attack is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

assaultvest.name: Assault Vest
assaultvest.desc: Holder's Sp. Def is 1.5x, but it can only select damaging moves.

lifeorb.name: Life Orb
lifeorb.desc: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

choicespecs.name: Choice Specs
choicespecs.desc: Holder's Sp. Atk is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

airballoon.name: Air Balloon
airballoon.desc: Holder is immune to Ground-type attacks. Pops when holder is hit.

heavydutyboots.name: Heavy-Duty Boots
heavydutyboots.desc: When switching in, the holder is unaffected by hazards on its side of the field.

leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.desc: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

lumberry.name: Lum Berry
lumberry.desc: Holder cures itself if it has a non-volatile status or is confused. Single use.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 for each of its stats that is lowered by a foe.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.

zerotohero.name: Zero to Hero
zerotohero.desc: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.desc: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.desc: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.

quickfeet.name: Quick Feet
quickfeet.desc: If this Pokemon is statused, its Speed is 1.5x; ignores Speed drop from paralysis.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.desc: Sunny Day active or Booster Energy used: highest stat is 1.3x, or 1.5x if Speed.

baddreams.name: Bad Dreams
baddreams.desc: Causes sleeping foes to lose 1/8 of their max HP at the end of each turn.

clearbody.name: Clear Body
clearbody.desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

supremeoverlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supremeoverlord.desc: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.

purifyingsalt.name: Purifying Salt
purifyingsalt.desc: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.
